1. Introduction

1.1 Kessler State University (the “University”) is seeking proposals from qualified firms to provide custodial services for the buildings listed in Exhibit A – Buildings in Scope, located on the Main Campus, the Health Sciences Campus (2.4 miles east of the Main Campus) and the Downtown Center. The University enrolls approximately 14,200 students, of whom approximately 3,100 live on campus.

1.2 The University intends to award one contract for all buildings. Proposers shall price every building in Exhibit D; partial proposals will not be considered.

2. Contract Term

2.1 The initial contract term shall be July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2028. The University may renew the contract for four (4) additional one-year periods, for a maximum of five (5) years, subject to satisfactory performance and the availability of funds.

3. Current Contract

3.1 Custodial services for the Exhibit A buildings are currently provided by Allpoint Custodial Group, LLC under Contract No. KSU-C-21-0447, awarded in 2021 for a term of five (5) years including renewals. The total value of the current contract is $14,950,000. Contract documents are available upon request under the Missouri Sunshine Law.

4. Scope Summary

4.1 The Contractor shall clean each building listed in Exhibit A on the number of service days per week shown in Column H, to APPA Level 2 (“Ordinary Tidiness”) unless the Remarks column or Exhibit B specifies APPA Level 1 for clinical and simulation spaces.

4.2 Square footages: Column D is gross square footage from the University facilities inventory and is provided for reference; Column E is cleanable square footage and is the basis for the Exhibit C staffing workbook. Buildings with zero (0) service days are listed for information only and shall not be priced.

4.3 Residence halls: service covers common areas (lobbies, lounges, corridors, laundry rooms) and community restrooms only. Student rooms and suite bathrooms are excluded. Residence halls require service seven (7) days per week while the halls are open, and a thorough cleaning at the end and the beginning of each semester.

4.4 Hours: evening service shall be performed between 5:00 PM and 1:30 AM. Weekend service at seven-day buildings shall be performed between 7:00 AM and 3:30 PM. The Contractor shall provide day porters at the Student Union and Boreham Library from 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM, Monday through Friday.

4.5 The Contractor shall furnish all labor, supervision, equipment, chemicals and consumables (paper products, hand soap and liners).

5. Staffing Workbook

5.1 Proposers shall complete Exhibit C – RFP Staffing Workbook showing, for each building, the number of custodial FTEs by shift, the assumed cleanable square feet per FTE, and supervisory staffing. Staffing will be evaluated for consistency with the proposed price.

6. Addendum No. 1 – Questions and Answers (issued November 3, 2026)

Q1. Exhibit A does not list Ridgeview Commons, which opened in August 2026. Is this building in scope?

A1. Yes. Building 1114, Ridgeview Commons, is added to Exhibit A: 11,000 gross square feet, 9,350 cleanable square feet, one (1) floor, 14 restroom fixtures, service seven (7) days per week. Proposers shall add this building to Exhibit D.

Q2. Exhibit A lists Building 2210, Nursing and Allied Health, at 48,210 gross square feet, but the University's published space inventory shows a smaller figure. Which is correct?

A2. The Exhibit A value is a transposition error. The gross square footage of Building 2210 is 42,810. Cleanable square footage (36,400) is unchanged.

Q3. Should Hawthorne Hall (Building 0084) be priced?

A3. No. Hawthorne Hall will close for renovation in May 2027 and remain offline through August 2028. It is removed from the scope of this RFP. The row remains in Exhibit A for information only.

Q4. Is the TOTAL row in Exhibit A the square footage to be priced?

A4. No. The TOTAL row is a simple sum of every row on the tab, including buildings listed for information only. Pricing is entered per building in Exhibit D.

Q5. How many custodial FTEs does the incumbent currently staff?

A5. The incumbent currently staffs approximately 118 custodial FTEs and 9 supervisors across all three locations.

All other terms and conditions of RFP #27031 remain unchanged. Proposers shall acknowledge receipt of Addendum No. 1 on the Proposal Form.
